name: Broadcasting
tagline: Tell stories through video, audio, and live production.
description: The Broadcasting pathway teaches students to plan, shoot, edit, and deliver video and audio content, from news packages to live broadcasts. Students work hands-on with cameras, editing software, and studio equipment used in real television and streaming production.

sequence.title: Intro to Digital Technology
sequence.desc: Foundational course covering digital media tools and concepts.

sequence.title: Digital Media: Audio & Video Production I
sequence.desc: Camera operation, audio capture, and non-linear editing basics.

sequence.title: Digital Media: Audio & Video Production II — Broadcast
sequence.desc: Studio production, live broadcast workflow, and advanced editing.
